ground.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production diffuse/albedo terrain material for an original dark fantasy isometric action RPG. Make a single square seamless tiling texture of an abandoned medieval cloister floor: irregular large grey slate flagstones, hairline cracks and worn chiselled edges, dark brown earth compacted in narrow joints, a few tiny dull moss fibres. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic material scan, no perspective. Physically believable detailed stone surface with restrained local contrast. Neutral soft FLAT DIFFUSE illumination only: absolutely no directional lighting, cast shadows, circular shadow/light patches, ambient occlusion blobs, vignette or highlights. The floor must have no circular stains, no large isolated hero object, no grass tufts sticking up, no game props, no bones, no characters, no inscriptions, no symbols, no text, no UI, no border. Subdued grey and earth palette suitable beneath bright fire/ice/lightning combat; not toy low-poly, not cartoon. Exact seamless continuity on all four edges, fairly even pattern frequency across canvas. Fill image only with the surface. This is independent new artwork; do not reproduce a named game asset.

props.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent environment prop sprite atlas for an original mature dark-fantasy isometric action RPG. Create exactly 12 isolated game props in a precise 4-column by 3-row grid, equal cells, on a genuinely transparent background. Camera fixed orthographic looking down 48 degrees, same orientation and lighting for every prop, front three-quarter view. Weathered sculptural stone, worn iron, aged bark; detailed believable painted 3D-render finish, muted slate grey and umber with sparse dry moss, adult realistic scale, no cartoon low-poly toy appearance. Row1 left to right: intact tall gothic cloister stone column with carved capital; broken half column with jagged fracture; ruined pointed stone arch with two feet; low broken monastery stone wall segment. Row2 left to right: eroded stone grave marker with subtle cross-shaped silhouette but NO letters; cracked horizontal tomb slab; iron brazier on stone pedestal with a restrained amber ember flame; gnarled leafless dead tree. Row3 left to right: exposed tangled root cluster; dry thorn shrub; a different low dead bramble cluster; scattered fractured stone masonry rubble. IMPORTANT: every complete prop must fit entirely inside its OWN cell using only60% of cell height/width, leaving wide TRANSPARENT gutters on all sides. Feet/ground-contact points near75% cell height. Tree, arch, roots, wall and rubble must not overlap adjacent cells. No platforms or attached ground tiles, no cast shadows onto background, no baked round shadow blobs, no characters, no environment/background scene, no text, numbers, labels, gridlines, UI or borders. Ground contact must be easy to anchor in an engine. All12 props are separate useful assets, not a conceptart scene. New independent artwork, not a named game's assets.
